basic_info.description: Built in 2015 this spectacular 2 story state of the art view single family dwelling is located in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. 3 bdrms on top floor, with 2.5 spa style baths, luxury upgrades throughout with high-end fixtures and finishes, phenomenal view living room with amazing lush green views of the San Francisco Golf Club, open concept eat in Viking kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances including 6 burner stove with grill, dining area seats 10-12 and opens to a wonderful garden. The spectacular primary en-suite with amazing views is bright and airy & features custom built-ins, huge walk-in closet, and sumptuous spa bath w tub & stall shower.  Located on a prime block in this sought-after neighborhood, 800 Summit provides a private dog park, playground, & 2 acre park featuring a spectacular Benjamin Bufano 'Peace' sculpture, plus top-rated schools incl Chinese American International School, Lowell High School, St. Ignatius College Preparatory, The Brandeis School. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate proximity to world class courses such as San Francisco Golf Club, The Olympic Club, Lake Merced Golf Club,& Harding Park. Close proximity to premiere shopping and restaurants in West Portal Village. Enjoy all the amenities of the Stonestown Galleria shopping mall
